natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: Current data shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrates that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful action. Memory_86 shows shortening onboarding lifted early adoption. These are complementary levers. Activation messaging is lower-risk than promotional_pricing (memory_73 shows 40% discount cuts 30-day retention 12%), avoids the false economy of referral_incentive on price-sensitive accounts losing to competitors, and addresses the immediate activation decline without requiring sales ops scaling. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 to confirm magnitude of impact and whether messaging approach can be adapted for SMB segment specifically affected by competitor pricing pressure. Standard experiment scale balances learning velocity against week's single deployment window.
